purpose: Criticize a mismatch between someone’s circumstances and behavior.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Plain form + くせに; noun + の / な-adjective + な + くせに
Even though he knows, he will not tell me.
They are strict with others even though they themselves are late.
Although she is scared, she is acting unconcerned.
formation: Plain form + くせに; noun + の / な-adjective + な + くせに
restrictions: Often targets the same person in both clauses; can sound insulting.
mistake: Use のに for a more neutral contrast.
